sources.finding: Documented SPI identifies running-process records. Birth timestamp is not an exposed field; reserved bytes remain opaque. Atomic coverage of all terminating/pending-I/O objects is not expressly established by this documentation.

Official public SDK header confirms SPI Reserved1[48] and exposed ImageName/PID/SessionId; its parent slot is reserved. The full thread structure is published. Current URL was read; no immutable source commit is claimed.
Creation FILETIME is available through PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION retained handles. Unavailable handles remain explicit unknowns.
A completely filled PID array can be truncated without a distinct error. Grow within a finite cap or reject; cross-provider agreement alone does not fix missing births.
CreationDate is supplemental provider datetime; conversion does not establish exact100ns source precision or atomic completeness.
Use finite OperationTimeoutSec as one provider bound, plus a separately retained finite caller deadline.
FilterHashtable+MaxEvents bounds selected projected events; cap saturation/access/retention/clear gaps remain unknown.

Documented clock-change event has PreviousTime/NewTime and is described as always logged. An empty query cannot establish historical coverage or continuity; account fields must not enter public projection.
QPC is independent of UTC/system-time adjustments. Current UTC/QPC bracketing cannot reconstruct a past unobserved clock interval.
